title: How the picks did
description: The recorded picks, scored after each session, and the held-out check behind the chances.

list.name: family
list.label: Model
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT substr(model_version, 1, instr(model_version, '/') - 1) FROM summary_pick ORDER BY 1
list.definition: SELECT DISTINCT substr(model_version, 1, instr(model_version, '/') - 1) FROM summary_pick ORDER BY 1
list.description: Which model's recorded picks and held-out check to show. sklearn-nextday-... is tomorrow.sh.

options.content: **How the recorded picks did.** A pick is scored once its session has closed (the evening refresh, or `stock-predictor scorecard`). *Reached* means the price got to the target after the run (for tomorrow.sh, above the next open; with a stop, before the stop). The **held-out check** below is the month a twin of the model was tested on without having seen it.

panels.title: Reached the target, by session
panels.description: For each scored session, across every recorded run: the share that reached the target among flagged stocks, stocks with 50%+, each run's top 5, and every stock.

targets.queryText:
SELECT session_date AS "Session",
       100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN flagged = 1 THEN hit END) / NULLIF(SUM(flagged = 1), 0) AS "Flagged",
       100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN passed = 1 THEN hit END) / NULLIF(SUM(passed = 1), 0) AS "50%+",
       100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN rank <= 5 THEN hit END) / NULLIF(SUM(rank <= 5), 0) AS "Top 5",
       100.0 * AVG(hit) AS "Every stock"
FROM summary_pick WHERE model_version LIKE '${family}/%' AND scored_at IS NOT NULL AND session_date BETWEEN date($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch', '+5 hours', '+30 minutes') AND date($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch', '+5 hours', '+30 minutes')
GROUP BY session_date ORDER BY session_date
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT session_date AS "Session",
       100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN flagged = 1 THEN hit END) / NULLIF(SUM(flagged = 1), 0) AS "Flagged",
       100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN passed = 1 THEN hit END) / NULLIF(SUM(passed = 1), 0) AS "50%+",
       100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN rank <= 5 THEN hit END) / NULLIF(SUM(rank <= 5), 0) AS "Top 5",
       100.0 * AVG(hit) AS "Every stock"
FROM summary_pick WHERE model_version LIKE '${family}/%' AND scored_at IS NOT NULL AND session_date BETWEEN date($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch', '+5 hours', '+30 minutes') AND date($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch', '+5 hours', '+30 minutes')
GROUP BY session_date ORDER BY session_date

panels.title: Sessions
panels.description: Runs, scored stock-predictions, flagged ones and how many reached the target.

targets.queryText:
SELECT session_date AS "Session", COUNT(DISTINCT as_of) AS "Runs", COUNT(*) AS "Scored",
       SUM(flagged = 1) AS "Flagged", SUM(CASE WHEN flagged = 1 THEN hit ELSE 0 END) AS "Flagged reached",
       100.0 * AVG(hit) AS "Every stock %", 100.0 * AVG(base_rate) AS "Base rate %"
FROM summary_pick WHERE model_version LIKE '${family}/%' AND scored_at IS NOT NULL AND session_date BETWEEN date($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch', '+5 hours', '+30 minutes') AND date($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch', '+5 hours', '+30 minutes')
GROUP BY session_date ORDER BY session_date DESC
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT session_date AS "Session", COUNT(DISTINCT as_of) AS "Runs", COUNT(*) AS "Scored",
       SUM(flagged = 1) AS "Flagged", SUM(CASE WHEN flagged = 1 THEN hit ELSE 0 END) AS "Flagged reached",
       100.0 * AVG(hit) AS "Every stock %", 100.0 * AVG(base_rate) AS "Base rate %"
FROM summary_pick WHERE model_version LIKE '${family}/%' AND scored_at IS NOT NULL AND session_date BETWEEN date($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch', '+5 hours', '+30 minutes') AND date($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch', '+5 hours', '+30 minutes')
GROUP BY session_date ORDER BY session_date DESC

panels.title: Chance against what happened
panels.description: Scored predictions grouped by the chance given: how often they reached the target. A model whose chances can be taken at face value has its bars near the diagonal (a 60-70% group reaching it about 65% of the time).

targets.queryText:
SELECT printf('%d-%d%%', CAST(chance * 10 AS INTEGER) * 10, CAST(chance * 10 AS INTEGER) * 10 + 10) AS "Chance given",
       100.0 * AVG(hit) AS "Reached", 100.0 * AVG(chance) AS "Said", COUNT(*) AS "Predictions"
FROM summary_pick WHERE model_version LIKE '${family}/%' AND scored_at IS NOT NULL AND session_date BETWEEN date($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch', '+5 hours', '+30 minutes') AND date($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch', '+5 hours', '+30 minutes')
GROUP BY CAST(chance * 10 AS INTEGER) ORDER BY CAST(chance * 10 AS INTEGER)
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT printf('%d-%d%%', CAST(chance * 10 AS INTEGER) * 10, CAST(chance * 10 AS INTEGER) * 10 + 10) AS "Chance given",
       100.0 * AVG(hit) AS "Reached", 100.0 * AVG(chance) AS "Said", COUNT(*) AS "Predictions"
FROM summary_pick WHERE model_version LIKE '${family}/%' AND scored_at IS NOT NULL AND session_date BETWEEN date($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch', '+5 hours', '+30 minutes') AND date($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch', '+5 hours', '+30 minutes')
GROUP BY CAST(chance * 10 AS INTEGER) ORDER BY CAST(chance * 10 AS INTEGER)

panels.title: Edge against what happened (live)
panels.description: Scored predictions grouped by edge (chance minus the base rate, in points): how often they reached the target, against the base rate for the same predictions. The held-out version of this is below.

targets.queryText:
SELECT CASE WHEN e < 0 THEN 'below 0' WHEN e < 5 THEN '0 to +5' WHEN e < 10 THEN '+5 to +10'
            WHEN e < 15 THEN '+10 to +15' WHEN e < 20 THEN '+15 to +20' ELSE '+20 or more' END AS "Edge",
       100.0 * AVG(hit) AS "Reached", 100.0 * AVG(base_rate) AS "Base rate", COUNT(*) AS "Predictions"
FROM (SELECT ROUND((chance - base_rate) * 100, 6) AS e, hit, base_rate FROM summary_pick
      WHERE model_version LIKE '${family}/%' AND scored_at IS NOT NULL AND session_date BETWEEN date($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch', '+5 hours', '+30 minutes') AND date($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch', '+5 hours', '+30 minutes') AND base_rate IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY MIN(e)
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT CASE WHEN e < 0 THEN 'below 0' WHEN e < 5 THEN '0 to +5' WHEN e < 10 THEN '+5 to +10'
            WHEN e < 15 THEN '+10 to +15' WHEN e < 20 THEN '+15 to +20' ELSE '+20 or more' END AS "Edge",
       100.0 * AVG(hit) AS "Reached", 100.0 * AVG(base_rate) AS "Base rate", COUNT(*) AS "Predictions"
FROM (SELECT ROUND((chance - base_rate) * 100, 6) AS e, hit, base_rate FROM summary_pick
      WHERE model_version LIKE '${family}/%' AND scored_at IS NOT NULL AND session_date BETWEEN date($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch', '+5 hours', '+30 minutes') AND date($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch', '+5 hours', '+30 minutes') AND base_rate IS NOT NULL)
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY MIN(e)

panels.title: Track record per stock
panels.description: Per stock, over the scored sessions in the time range: how often a run gave it 50%+ and it then reached the target, the same for flagged, and how often the call (yes at 50%+, else no) was right.

targets.queryText:
SELECT symbol AS "Stock", COUNT(*) AS "Checks",
       SUM(passed = 1) AS "Said 50%+", SUM(CASE WHEN passed = 1 THEN hit ELSE 0 END) AS "…and reached",
       SUM(flagged = 1) AS "Flagged", SUM(CASE WHEN flagged = 1 THEN hit ELSE 0 END) AS "…reached ",
       100.0 * AVG(hit) AS "Reached at all %",
       100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN (passed = 1) = (hit = 1) THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "Right %"
FROM summary_pick WHERE model_version LIKE '${family}/%' AND scored_at IS NOT NULL AND session_date BETWEEN date($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch', '+5 hours', '+30 minutes') AND date($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch', '+5 hours', '+30 minutes')
GROUP BY symbol ORDER BY SUM(flagged = 1) DESC, SUM(passed = 1) DESC, symbol
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT symbol AS "Stock", COUNT(*) AS "Checks",
       SUM(passed = 1) AS "Said 50%+", SUM(CASE WHEN passed = 1 THEN hit ELSE 0 END) AS "…and reached",
       SUM(flagged = 1) AS "Flagged", SUM(CASE WHEN flagged = 1 THEN hit ELSE 0 END) AS "…reached ",
       100.0 * AVG(hit) AS "Reached at all %",
       100.0 * AVG(CASE WHEN (passed = 1) = (hit = 1) THEN 1.0 ELSE 0.0 END) AS "Right %"
FROM summary_pick WHERE model_version LIKE '${family}/%' AND scored_at IS NOT NULL AND session_date BETWEEN date($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch', '+5 hours', '+30 minutes') AND date($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch', '+5 hours', '+30 minutes')
GROUP BY symbol ORDER BY SUM(flagged = 1) DESC, SUM(passed = 1) DESC, symbol

panels.title: The held-out check: a twin of the model, tested on a month it had not seen
Any stock
panels.description: From the latest held-out check of this model: how often each set reached the target (the net is after costs, selling at the target or the close).

targets.queryText: SELECT base_hit AS "Any stock" FROM model_evaluation WHERE family = '${family}' AND model_version = (SELECT model_version FROM model_evaluation WHERE family = '${family}' ORDER BY sessions_to DESC, recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1)

panels.title: Held-out record by edge
panels.description: In the held-out month: how often stocks reached the target, by how far their chance sat above the base rate at the same point. This is what today.sh's flag (+10 or more) quotes.

targets.queryText:
SELECT CASE WHEN json_extract(b.value, '$.from') <= -100 THEN 'below 0'
            WHEN json_extract(b.value, '$.to') >= 100 THEN printf('%+d or more', json_extract(b.value, '$.from'))
            ELSE printf('%+d to %+d', json_extract(b.value, '$.from'), json_extract(b.value, '$.to')) END AS "Edge",
       100.0 * json_extract(b.value, '$.hit') AS "Reached", 100.0 * json_extract(b.value, '$.base') AS "Base rate",
       json_extract(b.value, '$.rows') AS "Checks"
FROM model_evaluation e, json_each(e.evaluation, '$.by_edge') b
WHERE e.model_version = (SELECT model_version FROM model_evaluation WHERE family = '${family}' ORDER BY sessions_to DESC, recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1)
ORDER BY json_extract(b.value, '$.from')
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT CASE WHEN json_extract(b.value, '$.from') <= -100 THEN 'below 0'
            WHEN json_extract(b.value, '$.to') >= 100 THEN printf('%+d or more', json_extract(b.value, '$.from'))
            ELSE printf('%+d to %+d', json_extract(b.value, '$.from'), json_extract(b.value, '$.to')) END AS "Edge",
       100.0 * json_extract(b.value, '$.hit') AS "Reached", 100.0 * json_extract(b.value, '$.base') AS "Base rate",
       json_extract(b.value, '$.rows') AS "Checks"
FROM model_evaluation e, json_each(e.evaluation, '$.by_edge') b
WHERE e.model_version = (SELECT model_version FROM model_evaluation WHERE family = '${family}' ORDER BY sessions_to DESC, recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1)
ORDER BY json_extract(b.value, '$.from')

panels.title: Held-out base rate and top 5, by time of day
panels.description: In the held-out month, at each 15-minute check: how often any stock reached the target from then, and the model's top 5 and the 5 most volatile. Empty for tomorrow.sh, which has one point, the open.

targets.queryText:
SELECT json_extract(p.value, '$.point') AS "Time",
       100.0 * json_extract(p.value, '$.base_hit') AS "Any stock",
       100.0 * json_extract(p.value, '$.model_hit') AS "Model's top 5",
       100.0 * json_extract(p.value, '$.intraday_volatility_hit') AS "Most volatile 5"
FROM model_evaluation e, json_each(e.evaluation, '$.by_point') p
WHERE e.model_version = (SELECT model_version FROM model_evaluation WHERE family = '${family}' ORDER BY sessions_to DESC, recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1)
ORDER BY json_extract(p.value, '$.point')
targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT json_extract(p.value, '$.point') AS "Time",
       100.0 * json_extract(p.value, '$.base_hit') AS "Any stock",
       100.0 * json_extract(p.value, '$.model_hit') AS "Model's top 5",
       100.0 * json_extract(p.value, '$.intraday_volatility_hit') AS "Most volatile 5"
FROM model_evaluation e, json_each(e.evaluation, '$.by_point') p
WHERE e.model_version = (SELECT model_version FROM model_evaluation WHERE family = '${family}' ORDER BY sessions_to DESC, recorded_at DESC LIMIT 1)
ORDER BY json_extract(p.value, '$.point')
